caption:
$200 a month: the median wholesale price of one kilowatt of colocation across 23 markets.

Colocation is priced by power, not floor space. A 250 kW suite at that median costs $50,000 a month, and metered electricity comes on top. One kW running all month draws 730 kWh: about $85 in Virginia and $197 in Singapore at indicative rates.

Location moves the kW price too, from $403 in Singapore to $173 in Northern Virginia.

Data: Coloprice Colocation Index (26 Oct 2026) and power benchmarks (25 Sep 2026). Sources on the last slide.
